name: flags
meaning: IS g_gameFlags (0x6ddf5c + 0x18 = 0x6ddf74): the existing GameFlags enum applies unchanged. Game_ResetState seeds it with 0xC010

name: cineState
meaning: IS the letterbox/cinematic state byte 0x6ddf78: 0 idle, 1 bars animating, 2 bars fully open (subtitles and voice allowed). Game_CanOpenMenu demands 0

name: camDebugMode
meaning: camera debug mode, passed as argument 2 of Camera_Update by Game_Frame (0x5603be): 0 normal, 1 stick-only eye nudge, 2 free camera (Camera_UpdateDebugFreeCam 0x55285d), >= 3 d-pad + stick nudge. Non-zero also makes Wolf/Robot_UpdateCamera skip their requests and blocks the inventory. Only writer: Game_ResetState zeroes it.
